title: Yu Hai, Yu Hai
stanzas: Yesu Bwana Mwokozi aishi milele, Najua kwamba Yupo pamoja na mimi;
Sauti nasikia, Rehema naona; Wakati namhitaji, yupo nami.
Ulinzi Wake upo naona dhahiri, Miguu ichokapo, sikati tama,
Najua an`ongoza kupota dhoruba, Siku ya kuja kwake nitamwona.
chorus: Yu hai, Yu hai, Yu hai Bwana Yesu! Atembea, azungumza nami siku zote.
Yu hai, Yu hai, kutoa uzima! Hivi ndivyo nijuavyo, Yu hai ndani yangu!
